status.interpretation: The reports retain their measured source hashes. For the listed FNIRT, SynthMorph, and dMRI routes, retained root exports and covered CLI subtrees have identical normalized ASTs, so the package-entry changes do not alter argument values, numerical calls, image outputs, or timings. Five implementation-level names were deliberately removed from the root public API and are not claimed as retained exports. The expanded fMRI lazy-export branch, including all listed surface exports, is disjoint from these routes. This is a source-equivalence record, not a new real-data run.

limits: This claim is restricted to the exact old and current hashes and covered routes listed above.

It does not attest the fMRI lazy-export route, its surface exports, or any numerical implementation under fnit.fmri; that complete branch is removed only to prove it is disjoint from the listed pre-existing routes.
It does not claim API compatibility for prepare_ukb_topup, prepare_ukb_eddy, TorchTBSS, TBSSResult, or TBSSConfig; those names were intentionally removed from the root public API.
It does not attest the changed connectome command or any early-dispatch command.
It does not replace the separate numerical-source attestations for FLIRT or SynthMorph resampling.
